arStrings.szText: Defensive Skill: Rocks surround you, granting an explosive shield.
{c_important}Earthen Bulwark{/c} self-restores {c_number}[SF_25*100|%|]{/c} of its own Barrier amount each second.

Rock shrapnel flies outward when {c_important}Earthen Bulwark{/c} is destroyed or expires, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_DAMAGE}{/c} to surrounding enemies. This damage is increased by {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} bonuses.

{c_important}Earthen Bulwark{/c} grants {c_number}[SF_28]{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}. In addition, {c_important}Earthen Bulwark{/c} summons {c_important}{u}Tectonic Spikes{/u}{/c} that deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_TOOLTIP_PAYLOAD}{/c} total damage to enemies around you.
Extends the {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} duration to {c_number}[SF_5]{/c} seconds and increase the base absorption amount to {c_number}[{SF_6+SF_9}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life.

You are {c_important}{u}Fortified{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_19*100|%|]{/c} per second while {c_important}Earthen Bulwark{/c} is active. In addition, Heal for {c_number}[SF_20*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life if {c_important}Earthen Bulwark{/c} is fully depleted from damage.
Casting {c_important}Earthen Bulwark{/c} makes you {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_22]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Earthen Bulwark{/c} grants {c_number}[SF_11*100|%|]{/c} Resource Cost Reduction while active.
